description.narrative:
"The proposed Transformative Carbon Asset Facility will support countries to implement market-based carbon pricing and sectoral mitigation measures, and in the process pilot new and innovative greenhouse (GHG) emission reduction crediting mechanisms, providing blueprints for efficient and low-cost mitigation globally and at scale. The mechanisms that will be piloted by the Facility will provide a financial incentive in the form of payments for verified emission reductions, or carbon credits. In testing these mechanisms the Facility will support large-scale crediting programs in developing countries, at a national, subnational, sectoral or city-wide level, by providing payments for carbon credits.
Looking at the longer term, beyond the support provided by the Facility, many countries have expressed an interest in market-based climate mitigation approaches. The activities financed by the Facility will also help establish institutional, regulatory and technical building blocks for carbon pricing in the implementing countries. These building blocks could in turn provide a robust infrastructure for countries to implement more ambitious carbon pricing instruments."
